scope: Actual Chromium WebGL2 desktop and phone layouts, original ejection into initial ocean swimming, and a declared original near-gulf checkpoint with offshore starting feet. Close-organism starting feet are fixtures; native keyboard/touch swimming generates contact, avoidance and injury. Underwater organism art comparisons use a labelled renderer camera and do not claim that initial-ocean Space performs a dive. Gulf DIVE uses native input. No damage, sting, acknowledgement or rescue result is assigned. Gulf has no physical tile recenter; fixed-field pause and movement are tested instead of fabricating a recenter. Physical Safari, hardware FPS and medical accuracy are untested.
